[ -n "$FACTORY_SESSION" ] && command -v factory >/dev/null && factory hook user-prompt-submit; exit 0
[ -n "$FACTORY_SESSION" ] && command -v factory >/dev/null || exit 0; factory hook stop; [ $? -eq 2 ] && exit 2; exit 0
[ -n "$FACTORY_SESSION" ] && command -v factory >/dev/null && factory hook stop-failure; exit 0

_NOTE: Template — real ~/.claude/settings.json is NOT version-controlled. make setup creates from template or jq-merges: permissions.allow is preserved from the live file (machine-specific), permissions.deny comes from THIS template (global policy — a machine-local deny entry gets overwritten), model/effortLevel/alwaysThinkingEnabled preserved from live, everything else from template. IMPORTANT: the merge is template-first, so a key that exists ONLY in the live settings.json is DROPPED on every make setup — any setting you want to keep must live HERE (this is why attribution/agentPushNotifEnabled are in this file). Global skills are VCS'd in dotfiles/skills/ and symlinked to ~/.claude/skills/ (auto-loaded everywhere). Per-repo skills live committed at <repo>/.claude/skills/. SUBAGENT MODEL: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL pins every subagent (built-in AND custom) to Sonnet; agents/*.md frontmatter `model:` overrides it, an explicit model param on the Agent call overrides both, and `subagent_type: fork` ignores all three by design (forks always inherit the parent). The pin alone is prose past that point — hooks.PreToolUse's `Agent` matcher (model-discipline.ts) is what actually enforces it: denies a worker on `model: fable` outright (no legitimate use) and denies `subagent_type: fork` from a Fable/Opus caller (read from the caller's own transcript, since PreToolUse carries no field for the calling session's model). `model: opus` is denied unless the call's description carries `[opus: <reason>]` — the sanctioned escalation for novel-hard logic, made grep-able. AUTO-COMPACT: autoCompactWindow 600000 (models are natively 1M; default compaction would be ~967k) — idleCompaction stays on (runs at ~54 min idle while the 1h cache is warm, cheaper than a cold 400k+ re-read). AskUserQuestion is denied (bare name drops the schema; unattended agents stall on the picker). CONTEXT TRIM: permissions.deny holds BARE tool names — a bare name drops the tool's schema from the system prompt entirely; a scoped rule (e.g. Bash(rm *)) does NOT (schema stays, call is blocked). Denied: Artifact (unused; large schema — paired with disableArtifact), EnterPlanMode/ExitPlanMode (plan mode unused). disableClaudeAiConnectors: no claude.ai MCP connectors are configured — kills the auto-fetch (surface reduction, not a token saving). syncClaudeAiSkills/syncClaudeAiPlugins false: skills and plugins live in this repo, not on the claude.ai account — no third source. attribution uses the OBJECT form ({commit:"",pr:""}, replaces the deprecated includeCoAuthoredBy) because the bare `false` form makes older CLIs skip the whole settings file. promptCacheTtl is deliberately unset: Max already defaults to 1h; crossSessionInbound is deliberately unset: its default (mode parity) auto-delivers bypass↔bypass, which every session here is. Deliberately NOT denied: most other candidates (NotebookEdit, SendMessage, CronCreate/Delete/List, RemoteTrigger, PushNotification, DesignSync) are already DEFERRED — names only, ~5 tokens each — so denying them costs capability for no real saving; SendMessage is load-bearing for resuming background agents. disableBundledSkills would be the largest saving but removes /code-review, /verify, /schedule et al — declined. Editing deny here propagates to every machine on the next make setup.
